profile.headline: Senior Web Developer At Etna Interactive
profile.geoLocationName: San Luis Obispo County, California, United States
profile.summary: Experienced in web and front-end development with a background in project management.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Provides mentorship for other technology team members through a growth-oriented work environment.

Focus on staying up-to-date on latest UX trends and benefits while distributing information and best practices to the company.

Keeps design system up-to-date for best practices and easy to implement reusable code.

Focuses on heavier duty front-end work including products and client websites.

Provides feedback and insight to other departments while mitigating challenges.

Codes and provides UX and front end development input into Etna plugins and products.

Provides smooth workflow by understanding and delegating support requests.

positions.title: Client Solutions & UX Specialist
positions.description:
Plans and designs company's application user interface with a focus on usability and customer experience.

Manages and develops the visual design of client's web stores and other web based applications.

Assists external clients in the implementation of our software.

Evaluates client's needs and develops configurations that support their business processes.

Manages multiple projects concurrently ensuring deadlines are met and projects are tracked. 

Leads integration between bLoyal and Woocommerce

Participates in software testing while interfacing with developers to ensure any bugs are resolved.

positions.title: Software Support Specialist
positions.description:
Assist clients with troubleshooting and resolving potential problems through telephone calls and support tickets

Train end-users on aspects of the loyalty program system to ensure a smooth and manageable understanding on the best way to use the system for the client.

Participated in software testing including interfacing with developers to insure any defects are resolved.

Reviewed and created training manuals to provide end-users with multiple forms of communication to assist with questions.

Managed client focused projects.

positions.title: Instructional Assistant
positions.description:
Tutor students in Computer Science based courses with a focus in Object-Oriented Programming

Grade student's homework including logic assignments as well as coded programs

positions.title: CS REU Student
positions.description:
I was one out of 10 students chosen for the REU program at Montana State University. 

Assisted in a graduate student's algorithms research of preemptive power scheduling. 

Worked with team members to research offline and online power scheduling algorithms, gathering data, sorting data

Combined the collective data into a Java written program to "create jobs" based on the jobs length, power consumption, time, and probability.

honors.title: Presidential Scholar
honors.description: The Presidential Scholar is awarded to undergraduate students who completes at least 12 graded  units with a minimum term grade point average of 3.85. I have received this award for multiple semesters.
honors.issuer: Issued by Humboldt State University · Jan 2013

projects.title: Pocket Coverter
projects.description: A simple number system converter, which handles Decimal, Binary, Hexadecimal, and Octal. Simple enter a number in one of the fields, and convert to the other types.
